interpretation.first_use_cost: Learning/discovery cost exceeds the small aggregate replay time saving in this one cohort; it must be included, not hidden. Shadow observation counts are not unique catalogue-wide candidates.
interpretation.not_established: No RL, generalization to unseen contexts, arithmetic/Q result, full generic point engine, new proof calculus, uniquely GCTS learning advantage, or statistically reproducible speedup.
interpretation.observed: Six newly selected singleton consequences have genuine additional marking exclusions in the saved point graph shadows and all six change point branching. Ordinary search receives exactly the same learned units and also reduces branching.

marking_effect.unique_scope: The same candidate can recur in many graph observations/boundaries. Distinct triple is case_id,boundary_index,candidate_id, derived by recomposing only the saved baseline selected union from its own baseline candidate definitions then comparing its compatible candidates to each saved actual marked graph. No new branch/search is generated. Baseline selected union AND baseline tested candidates suppress extra learned R marks.

saved_costs.clock_interpretation: All values are saved native integer differences. Do not add nested clocks to enclosing time. Modules loaded once, each state/model fresh; checks and shadow instrumentation are charged. Whole-case shared verification is separately reported, not allocated per arm. One cohort is not an isolated cold-arm or reproducible speedup study.
saved_costs.external_terminal_resource_acceptance: ROOT owns separate full native/caller reconciliation. This extraction does not read or requalify those records.
